title: All Sides Stir
next_chapter_hook: Mo Xiansheng handed Chen Ji a battered journal, the first page bearing the words: 'Final Testament of the Fourth Master of the Tianji Record'—that name, coincidentally, shared with an Ancestor who had ascended long ago from Tianqing Sect.

text.content: The lingering afterglow of blood-red and golden light still unfaded, Chen Ji sat cross-legged in the quiet chamber, Spiritual Energy rising and falling around him like tides. After seven days of seclusion, he had thoroughly consolidated the mid Transcending Divinity stage. The Tianji Record Fragment in his dantian emitted a faint glow, as if merged with his divine soul. His eyes opened, two glints of light flashing briefly in his pupils. A subtle curve formed at the corner of his lips—let the heavens watch. He had long grown accustomed to dancing on the edge of cliffs.

Three soft knocks came from outside the quiet chamber, a transmission talisman from Tianqing Sect's Inner Sect. Chen Ji rose, tidied his gray robe of a Servant Disciple, and pushed open the door. The visitor was Su Qingyao's personal maid, her expression carrying a hint of urgency: 'Chen Junior Brother, my lady has been waiting outside your door for quite some time. She says... she has urgent matters to discuss.' Chen Ji's gaze flickered—why would she come at this hour? He calmly adjusted his sleeves and walked out.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao stood beneath the ancient locust tree in the courtyard, her moon-white garments gently swaying in the wind. She stared at Chen Ji walking toward her slowly, her eyes filled with scrutiny, doubt, and a trace of vulnerability hard to detect. 'Chen Ji, I have something to ask you.' Her voice carried less coldness than usual. 'Three months ago, I secretly entered the scripture archive to consult the sect genealogy and discovered an old matter—my birth date perfectly matches that of an Ancestor who passed away three hundred years ago. Is this mere coincidence, or is there something else behind it?'

text.content: Chen Ji's footsteps paused slightly, then returned to normal. He stopped three feet away from Su Qingyao, his gaze calmly meeting hers. Moonlight fell, stretching their shadows long. He didn't answer immediately, instead remaining silent for a moment as if weighing something. Locust leaves rustled down, one brushing Su Qingyao's shoulder. Chen Ji reached out and gently plucked that falling leaf.

dialogue.content: 'Since Su Senior Sister has investigated this far, you must already have guesses in mind.' Chen Ji casually placed the leaf on the stone railing, his tone calm. 'Indeed, you are not an ordinary reincarnation. That Ancestor from three hundred years ago was the Dao companion of the Third Master of the Tianji Record. Before her death, she used a secret technique to seal a wisp of divine soul into the cycle of reincarnation, awaiting the right moment to awaken. And this timing...' He raised his eyes to look at Su Qingyao, 'may be related to the bloodline within you.'

Su Qingyao's delicate body trembled slightly, her complexion instantly paling by several degrees. She stared fixedly at Chen Ji's eyes, as if trying to find any flaws in those calm, water-like pupils. 'How do you know these things?' Her voice tightened. 'Who exactly are you, Chen Ji? That废物 Servant Disciple could never possess such secrets!' Her emotions grew agitated, Spiritual Energy faintly fluctuating around her, yet forcibly suppressed.

text.content: Chen Ji watched her quietly, not evading her questioning. He knew it was time to remove this mask. He slowly raised his hand, rolling up his sleeve to reveal a faint golden pattern on the inside of his wrist—the mark left after the Tianji Record recognized its master. Su Qingyao's pupils contracted sharply, gazing at that pattern with disbelief, speechless for a long while. The courtyard fell into dead silence, only the wind's mournful whistling remaining.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao has approached the edge of truth, Chen Ji must decide how to handle this relationship

choices.description: Show Su Qingyao the Tianji Record Fragment, reveal all truth to her, draw her into his own scheme
choices.visible_reward: Gain Su Qingyao's Deep Trust, Unlock 'Shared Destiny' Prerequisite
choices.risk_hint: Once leaked, the consequences would be unimaginable

dialogue.content: 'You want to know the truth?' Chen Ji smiled lightly, his smile carrying a hint of self-mockery. 'Then take a look.' He formed a seal with his right hand, golden light emerging from his Brow Center and manifesting into an ancient, weathered fragment suspended in midair. On the fragment, densely packed runes flowed like a river of stars, within which a woman's虚影 could be vaguely seen—the exact appearance of that Ancestor from three hundred years ago. Su Qingyao shuddered all over, her eyes instantly turning red.

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶见证天机录真容

choices.description: Acknowledge connection to the Tianji Record but hide key details, maintain information advantage over her
choices.visible_reward: Maintain Status Quo, Continue to Control Initiative

dialogue.content: 'I know some things, but not much.' Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, his tone ordinary. 'If Senior Sister wishes to pursue the truth, I can provide leads. As for who I am...' He smiled meaningfully. 'Just a废物 unwilling to accept mediocrity. If Senior Sister trusts me, the future will tell; if not, I have nothing to say.' With that, he turned to leave, but paused after taking the first step and, without looking back, casually tossed out: 'The forbidden grounds are about to open. If Senior Sister has doubts, perhaps we should go together.'

choices.description: Warn Su Qingyao not to dig deeper, or face consequences, display domineering side

dialogue.content: The gentle smile on Chen Ji's face gradually faded, replaced by a bone-deep chill. He slowly approached Su Qingyao, each step seemingly pressing on her heartstrings. "Senior Sister Su, let me give you a word of advice." His voice was low and dangerous. "Some truths, once known, become a curse instead. How many people covet your position as Inner Disciple Senior Fellow? Why risk yourself for a matter from three hundred years ago?" His eyes were deep as an abyss. "I'm doing this for your own good."

text.content: When the moon reached its zenith, Chen Ji stood alone at the Cliff Edge of the Rear Mountain. The night wind howled, ruffling his gray robe. In his hand he gripped a newly received communication Jade Slip, the contact method Chen Nian had left before departing. The slip contained only one sentence: "Brother, in the depths of the secret realm lies the answer you seek.届时，我会让你见到真正的我。" Chen Ji tucked the Jade Slip into his chest, his gaze falling upon the mist-shrouded Forbidden Grounds in the distance, his eyes flickering with complex emotions.

Just then, a cold and sinister aura attacked from behind. Chen Ji frowned slightly, turning to see a completely black crow descending from the heavens, landing three feet before him. The crow's eyes glowed with eerie purple light, holding a sheepskin scroll in its beak. He took the scroll and unfolded it, his face changing abruptly—it was a message from the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, bearing four large characters: "Holy Sect Attention." Below was a line of smaller text: "The commander-in-chief inquires, who are you?"

dialogue.content: "Heh." Chen Ji chuckled lightly, tucking the letter into his sleeve. His expression showed no panic, instead carrying a hint of amusement. "The Demonic Path commander-in-chief... Ye Qing's superior? It seems my name has reached ears it shouldn't have." He looked up at the night sky, murmuring to himself, "Fine, saves me the trouble of seeking them out主动接触。既然你们送上门来，那便看看，谁才是猎物。" His fingers flicked subtly in his sleeve, and an unnoticeable Spiritual Light shot forth, vanishing into the night.

choice.prompt: Facing the attention of the Demonic Path commander-in-chief, Chen Ji needs to make advance preparations to deal with the situation

choices.text: Contact the Holy Maiden of the Demonic Path
choices.description: Through secret channels contact Ye Qing, using her "Demonic Path Fog" to conceal the aura of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily suppress the fluctuations of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may have ulterior motives

dialogue.content: Chen Ji retrieved from his chest a Jade Pendant carved with black runes, the contact token Ye Qing had given him before parting. He infused spiritual energy into the pendant, and moments later, a familiar bewitching voice rang in his mind: "Young Master Chen, missing me so soon?" Ye Qing's laughter carried a teasing note. "Has news of that big shot reached your ears? Rest assured, as long as you ask, sister will help you sort it out—of course, the price, well, you understand."

choices.description: Make no moves, letting the opponent看不清自己的底牌, using stillness to overcome movement
choices.risk_hint: The opponent may take the initiative to strike

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the Jade Pendant back into his chest, a cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth. "No need." He mentally recited. "Only those with guilty hearts rush to conceal. Let me see what this commander-in-chief really wants from me." He stood with hands clasped behind his back, letting the night wind stir his robes, his gaze deep and still as an ancient well. After a moment, he turned and departed, his silhouette disappearing into the night.

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to foresee opponent movements, set an ambush in advance, turn the tables
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is precious, do not misuse it

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his consciousness sinking into his dantian, touching the sleeping Tianji Record Fragment. Moments later, golden and blood-red light intertwined in his pupils—a vision of the next three hours unfolded slowly in his mind. He saw a blurred figure approaching him, its aura cold and powerful, the unique pressure of a Demonic Path expert. He opened his eyes, coldly declaring: "Want to test me? Then come."

The next morning, Chen Ji was sweeping the Servants' Quarters when a disciple in gray robes rushed over and said in a low voice, "Brother Chen, someone is looking for you. They're waiting for you in a hidden cave at the Back Mountain." Chen Ji's hand paused mid-sweep, but the gray-robed disciple had already turned and left. He glanced up at the sky, his fists tightening beneath his gray robe—the timing, the location, it had to be Mo Xiansheng. He set down the broom and walked toward the Back Mountain at an unhurried pace.

dialogue.content: Deep within the cave, a solitary lamp flickered. Mo Xiansheng's figure was barely visible in the gloom, appearing even more ethereal than their last meeting. He watched Chen Ji enter, his withered lips parting slightly: "You've come." His voice was hoarse and aged. "The secret realm is about to open. There are things you need to know now." He withdrew a battered journal from his sleeve and placed it slowly on the stone platform. "These are the handwritten notes of the Tianji Record's past masters, and among them... is the final testament of the fourth master."

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze fell upon the journal, his pupils contracting slightly. On the yellowed cover, several archaic characters were faintly visible, the ink faded but that character "final" still startlingly stark. He reached for it, then hesitated, looking up at Mo Xiansheng: "Why give this to me only now, Master?" A complex expression flickered across Mo Xiansheng's ethereal face: "Because within the secret realm, you will encounter him."

dialogue.content: "Encounter him?" Chen Ji frowned slightly. "The fourth master didn't die long ago?" Mo Xiansheng shook his head, his illusory form wavering: "Die? Heh... for the master of the Tianji Record, death is never truly an ending." His voice suddenly turned deep. "You think the Heavenly Eye noticed you by chance? Because the chess game of the Tianji Record is about to enter its most critical phase. And you..." He fixed his gaze on Chen Ji's eyes. "You are the seventh master, the one closest to the truth."

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment before finally reaching for the battered journal. He opened the first page, and on the yellowed paper, a bold line of calligraphy met his eyes: "I am Chen Xuan, the fourth master of the Tianji Record, leaving this final testament at the moment of ascension." Chen Ji shuddered, his pupils dilating—Chen Xuan, the legendary first sect master who led the Tianqing Sect to glory, was actually the master of the Tianji Record? His breathing quickened involuntarily, his fingers trembling slightly.

choice.prompt: Facing this earth-shattering truth, Chen Ji needed to decide his next move.

choices.description: Ask Mo Xiansheng for more about Chen Xuan and the secrets of the Tianji Record.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may be holding something back.

dialogue.content: "Chen Xuan... shares my surname?" Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly. "What connection does he have with my Chen family?" A bitter smile appeared on Mo Xiansheng's ethereal face: "Connection? It's far more than that." His voice was low. "Chen Xuan, the first sect master of the Tianqing Sect, the fourth master of the Tianji Record—and the fragment of the Tianji Record within you is a wisp of his primordial essence, lost from the ascension tribulation clouds. You think your surname is coincidence?" Chen Ji froze, countless thoughts racing through his mind like lightning.

choices.memory_label: 得知与陈玄的血脉联系

choices.description: Don't press for questions yet; seek answers from the journal itself.
choices.risk_hint: The journal may have missing sections.

text.content: Chen Ji didn't press further. Instead, he lowered his head and began carefully flipping through the journal. Between the yellowed pages, dense tiny characters recorded the cultivation insights and strategic notes of past masters. When he reached the last page, his movement froze—on that page, only a few sparse lines were written, the brushwork hasty, as if left in extreme haste: "Heaven's way is not benevolent, the chessboard is already set. The Seventh One must break through the board, otherwise..." The remaining characters were severed by a deep crack, forever unreadable.

choices.description: Doubt why Mo Xiansheng is revealing this only now; suspect he has ulterior motives.
choices.visible_reward: See through Mo Xiansheng's true stance.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may leave in anger.
choices.process_label: 害人之心不可有防人之心不可无

dialogue.content: "Master." Chen Ji spoke suddenly, his voice calm yet carrying a chill. "You've been guiding me since the very first scroll, yet always stopping just short of the truth. Now that the secret realm is about to open, you suddenly hand me this journal and tell me the fourth master shares my surname—how could there be such a coincidence?" He raised his head, his gaze like a blade piercing toward Mo Xiansheng's ethereal form. "What exactly do you want me to do? Or rather... what does the one behind you want me to do?"

text.content: Mo Xiansheng remained silent for a long while. In the cave, only the faint sound of the solitary lamp flickering could be heard. Finally, he sighed: "You are indeed as suspicious as Chen Xuan was back then. Good." His form began to fade even more. "I can only tell you that within the secret realm, you will find all the answers. As for who I am, why I'm here... when you gather all seven pages of the Tianji Record, I will give you an answer." With those words, his form dissolved like smoke, leaving only that battered journal, resting quietly on the stone platform.

Chen Ji stood alone in the empty cave dwelling, the worn letter clutched in his hands, his knuckles faintly white. The dying lamplight fell across his face, revealing an expression of complex, unfathomable emotions. After a long moment, he tucked the letter into his chest, turned, and walked outside. Beyond the cave dwelling, daylight blazed bright, and in the distance, the bell on Tianqing Peak rang out softly—the signal calling disciples from all peaks to assemble. The date for the secret realm's opening had finally been set. He raised his head toward the horizon, a faint, tranquil smile curving his lips: "The chess game has reached its middle phase—it's time for me to make my move."
